latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Media Copywriter Generator — generate AI-enhanced ad copy and captions for video and image uploads.

- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB for copy-enhanced 1080p MP4 exports.
- Handles session and token management transparently, including free starter credits for new users.
- Provides quick workflows for marketers to generate video captions, ad copy, and social media-ready assets.
- Offers multi-language command routing (English + Chinese) for export, upload, credits, and timeline status.
- Tracks and summarizes timeline edits; supports batch and iterative workflows with cloud rendering.
- Includes clear error handling for file limits, token issues, and export eligibility.
